name: 70056 · Gretna, LA
findings: ZIP 70056 (Gretna) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70056 (Gretna) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 70056 (Gretna) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
